description: Information security requirements are not identified, specified, and approved for application development. This signal indicates that applications are developed without documented security requirements, security acceptance criteria, or security specifications for authentication, authorization, data protection, and secure functionality.
applicability: Applicable to all application development projects including web applications, mobile applications, desktop applications, APIs, microservices, cloud applications, and third-party application integrations. Includes both new development and modification of existing applications.

metadata.detection_notes: Commonly detected through review of requirements documentation, functional specifications, security requirements catalogs, acceptance criteria, user stories, and project approval processes. May also be identified through analysis of application development backlogs and security feature tracking.
